أقتفي (form VIII)
# أَقْتَفِي (ʔaqtafī) /ʔaq.ta.fiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# أَقْتَفِيَ (ʔaqtafiya) /ʔaq.ta.fi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
